Payment Processing and Collections

When it comes to billing and collections for your water utility, it's important to have a reliable and secure payment processing system in place. At Axis Meter Solutions, we understand the importance of timely and accurate payments, as well as effective collections strategies to ensure cash flow.
Online Payments and Security

Our online payment portal allows your customers to conveniently pay their bills from anywhere, at any time. We use secure payment gateways to ensure that all transactions are safe and protected from fraud. Customers can pay with Visa, Mastercard, or other major credit cards, as well as through electronic check payments.
Direct Payments and Remittance Processing

In addition to online payments, we also offer direct payment options for customers who prefer to have their bills automatically deducted from their bank accounts. This can help ensure that payments are made on time and reduce the risk of late or missed payments. Our remittance processing system ensures that payments are accurately recorded and credited to the correct customer accounts.
Handling Collections and Cash Flow

At Axis Meter Solutions, we understand the importance of effective collections strategies to ensure that your utility maintains positive cash flow. Our experienced collections team is trained to handle delinquent accounts with sensitivity and professionalism, while also taking the necessary steps to recover unpaid balances. We work with customers to set up payment plans and offer other solutions to help them get back on track with their bill payments.

With our expertise in utility management and sub-metering, Axis Meter Solutions is the best option for your water billing and collections needs. Our metrics speak for themselves, including a 32% average property value increase and 18% lower operating costs. Plus, we're 100% regulatory compliant, so you can trust that your utility is in good hands.
